input.quote: a. it will perform the Services using reasonable care and skill and in accordance with the applicable Service Option Attachments
input.rationale: Section 5.1 gives only a care-and-skill warranty for Services plus authority and a law-compliance covenant; there is no conformance warranty for Deliverables/Materials, no no-malicious-code warranty and no stated remedy (repair, replacement, re-performance or refund). Section 5.4(c) then provides all Materials "AS IS" without warranty of any kind, which swallows any conformance protection, and 5.2 makes 5.1 exclusive. This falls short of the preferred position, so we add a 90-day conformance and malicious-code warranty with an express remedy and carve the Section 5.1 warranties out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.

proposal.summary: Add a Materials/Deliverable conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with a repair/re-perform/refund remedy, and carve the express warranty out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a 90-day conformance warranty for delivered Materials, a no-malicious-code warranty and an express repair/re-performance/refund remedy, since Section 5.1 currently gives us no conformance warranty or remedy at all. We have also carved the Section 5.1 warranties out of the Section 5.4(c) "AS IS" disclaimer so that the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty; we can discuss a shorter period if IBM prefers.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Deliverable and all Materials delivered by IBM will conform in all material respects to their applicable documentation and specifications, and will not contain any virus, malicious or disabling code. Customer's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Deliverable or Materials, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, Deliverable or Materials.

ops.newText: c. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS
